name: Community Festival & Cultural Gathering
description: Large-scale public or society gathering requiring civic permits, staging, crowds, volunteer logistics, and community food.

default_budget_split.reasoning: Risers, line-array speakers, LED walls, stage lighting, and tech engineer.
Prasad/langar/community feast, water stations, eco-friendly disposables.
Shamiana/canopy, security barricades, generator backup, portable sanitation.
Police NOC, fire department clearance, ambulance standby, security bouncers.
Folk dancers, singers, sound artists, and guest honorarium.
Directional banners, volunteer t-shirts, walkie-talkie rentals.
Reserve for sudden rain protection, overtime equipment, medical supplies.

timeline_milestones.title: Book Public Grounds & Power Substation Connections
Confirm Stage, Sound System & Generator Contracts
Launch Volunteer Drive & Form Safety Marshall Squads
Finalize Community Feast Menu & Food Hygiene Checklist
Stage Rigging, Sound Check & Fire Extinguisher Inspection
Crowd Gates Open, Volunteer Briefing & Program Rollout

tone: Inspiring, communal, well-organized, welcoming, and civic-minded.
